meta.title: Discarding a colleague's draft award is not creator-scoped
gaps: The available vocabulary cannot create buyer A's draft proposal and invoke the discard operation as buyer B of the same company.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer opens an award proposal.
The buyer sends the award proposal call, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with a clear message, and never with a server error.
